meta.name: SisoHome Design Philosophy
meta.note: Mockups are a design reference only. Rebrand to SisoHome; keep the design language. Light-first, dark mode supported via inverse tokens.

philosophy: Light, calm, professional property-operations workspace — near-white canvas, white surfaces, thin borders, very low shadow.
One dominant accent (emerald green) marks active/selected state; primary actions are near-black filled buttons.
Information-dense tables on desktop degrade to friendly cards on mobile — never horizontal scrolling for core workflows.
Every page follows the same skeleton: header → tabs → toolbar → data region. Learn once, use everywhere.
Status is always color + dot + word (never color alone) for accessibility.
Touch-first: 44px minimum targets, bottom-anchored feedback, sidebar becomes a sheet on mobile.

surfaceSubtle.usage: table header row, kanban column bg, input fills

ink.usage: primary text, primary buttons, active nav label

accent.usage: active tab underline+label, success text, Message button text

overline.usage: sidebar section labels: QUICK ACTIONS / MENU / HELP & SUPPORT

shadow.card: none — cards rely on 1px border + white surface

layout.frame: Rounded app frame floating on canvas (desktop); full-bleed on mobile.

sidebar.activeItem: white pill: 1px border + navActive shadow + ink label
sidebar.mobile: off-canvas Sheet via hamburger trigger (44px), swipe-to-dismiss

headerActions: primary: near-black filled button with leading icon

navigation.note: Menu labels per mockups; evolve toward sisohome.md §8 (Utilities & Service Schedules, Staff & Service Providers, Settings & Integrations) as domain phases land. Visibility filtered by permission (hasUiPermission) — never show what the server would deny.

components.primaryButton: bg-ink text-white rounded-lg h-11, leading icon, active:scale-[0.98]
components.secondaryButton: bg-surface text-ink border border-borderStrong rounded-lg h-11
components.statusBadge: rounded-full, semantic bg + fg, 6px leading dot + word
components.statRow: single card, 4 equal columns, 1px vertical dividers, overline label + metric + delta(linear up/down color)
components.tabs: line style, active = accent text + 2px accent underline, inactive = inkSecondary, horizontal scroll on mobile
components.toolbar: search input + outline filter chips + optional Filter button; wraps to scrollable chip row on mobile
components.dataTable: sticky surfaceSubtle header row (caption, inkSecondary), rows with 40px thumbnail + title/subtitle stack, right-aligned numeric column, action cell = primary View + outline Edit
components.peopleCard: avatar top-left + overflow menu, name, phone, divider, label:value stat rows, footer with accentSoft Message button + outline View Profile button
components.kanbanColumn: surfaceSubtle column bg, overline header + count pill, white ticket cards: id (caption), title (2 lines), property (muted), priority badge, assignee avatar+name + icon buttons
components.search: input with leading Search icon, ⌘K hint chip on desktop

patterns.pageHeader: h1 title + muted subtitle; actions right (date-range pill, primary, secondary)
patterns.tabsPerSection: each module opens with tabs (Portfolio: Properties|Units|Keys & Locks|Equipment|Inspection; People: Tenants|Owners|Service Pros; Maintenance: Requests Board|Recurring)
patterns.onboarding: post-signup step: full-height single-column card — either list of organizations to join (org row + Join action) OR kind-selection cards (Landlord / Property Management / Maintenance Company) with icon, title, description; one primary CTA; identical at 375px
patterns.emptyState: illustration/icon + title + description + primary action (use EmptyState from page-shell)
patterns.loading: Skeleton rows (never bare spinner) — use PageShell / ResponsiveDataListing skeleton
patterns.count: bold word + muted total next to list title (e.g. 'Properties Total 19')

mobile.nav: hamburger → Sheet (left), full-height, swipe-dismiss; user chip at bottom
mobile.tables: ResponsiveDataListing → stacked cards with key fields + action buttons
mobile.kanban: column status tabs (scrollable chips) + vertical card list, or horizontal snap-scroll
mobile.filters: scrollable chip row or bottom Sheet; never desktop dropdowns
mobile.forms: UniversalForm single column, sticky FormFooter with primary action; inputs h-11 rounded-xl

themeTokens.note: Mapped into apps/web/app/theme.css on top of @workspace/ui globals. Update design.json first, then theme.css.

dark.note: Dark values are a secondary track — mockups are light-only; validate dark mode against this table before shipping.
